name: Harrisa and Mackerel Rigatoni
steps: Bring a large saucepan of well-salted water to the boil. Add the rigatoni and cook for 2 mins less than the pack instructions.
Meanwhile, finely chop most of the parsley and set aside, save the remaining leaves to serve.
Thinly slice the garlic. Place a frying pan over a medium heat with the olive oil. Add the garlic and cook for about 1 min until softened but not coloured.

Stir in the harissa paste and cook for 1 min more. Tip in the cherry tomatoes whole, then prick each one with a knife so the skins split. Use the back of a spoon or a potato masher to squash them slightly as they cook.
Add the mackerel, breaking it up gently with a spoon. Season well with salt and black pepper, then cook for 2 mins until everything is warmed through and saucy.

Using a slotted spoon, transfer the rigatoni straight into the sauce and toss well to coat, add in a big splash of pasta water. Squeeze in the juice from half of the lemon and stir in the chopped parsley. Taste and adjust the seasoning if needed.
Spoon into bowls, scatter over the remaining parsley and serve with the remaining lemon cut into wedges on the side.
